name: daily-book-reader

scripts.verify: npm run verify:baseline && npm run verify:races && npm run verify:theme
scripts.verify:baseline: npm run db:local && npm run seed:local && node scripts/verify-schema.mjs && npm run types && npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/verify-runtime.mjs dev && node scripts/verify-runtime.mjs built
scripts.verify:races: node scripts/verify-races.mjs dev && npm run build -- --mode reader-race-test && node scripts/verify-build-isolation.mjs race && node scripts/verify-races.mjs built && npm run build && node scripts/verify-build-isolation.mjs default
scripts.verify:theme: npm run types && npm run typecheck && npm run build -- --mode reader-theme-test && node scripts/verify-theme.mjs dev && node scripts/verify-theme.mjs built && npm run build && node scripts/verify-build-isolation.mjs default

description: Formal Daily Book reader: local-only schema and public read slice.
